meta.description: Add Matrix channel integration via Chat SDK. Works with any Matrix homeserver.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会把 Matrix 适配器从 channels 分支复制进 src/channels/、注册到 channel barrel、安装固定版本的适配器包、修补 matrix-js-sdk 的 ESM 导入并构建，让 NanoClaw 支持任意 Matrix homeserver 的房间与私聊。
howto.when: 当你想给 NanoClaw 加 Matrix 频道或提到 Matrix 集成时触发；机器人账号与凭据需人工在 Element 里注册、填写。

say.text: 帮我把 Matrix 频道加到 NanoClaw 里
say.note: 会复制适配器、装依赖并跑注册测试

say.text: Matrix 机器人要用访问令牌登录，帮我配一下
构建报 matrix-js-sdk 的 ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND
say.note: 重跑 ESM 补丁再 build

howto.what_en: Claude copies the Matrix adapter from the channels branch into src/channels/, registers it in the barrel, installs the pinned adapter package, patches matrix-js-sdk ESM imports, builds, and runs the registration test.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to add a Matrix channel to NanoClaw or mention a Matrix integration; the bot account and credentials are set up by hand in Element.

say_en.text: Add the Matrix channel to NanoClaw
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, installs deps, runs the test

say_en.text: Set up the bot to log in with an access token
Build fails with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND for matrix-js-sdk
say_en.note: Re-runs the ESM patch, then builds
